prompt:
CRIA / VIDEO DIRECTION — PRODUTO SOBRE O MUNDO

DELIVERY
15-second finished video, 16:9, 24fps delivery unless the sequence explicitly calls for time-lapse or slow motion. Timings describe the finished edit. If the selected generator supports shorter clips, generate each timed shot separately with the same references, then assemble the edit; do not cram the full narrative into one unsupported generation.
FRAME COMPOSITION: Native horizontal 16:9 video. Compose the action for this landscape frame; no pillarboxing or letterboxing.

REFERENCES
@image1 = Produto. Foto nítida do produto, incluindo embalagem e proporções.
Preserve reference identity, proportions, colors and materials, except for the one intentional effect explicitly described in the sequence. If the generator uses attachment slots instead of @image tokens, attach the same references in that order.

DIRECTION & CINEMATOGRAPHY
Product-level close followed by a separate virtual wide; product bokeh and deep landscape detail belong to different shots.
Cinema-drone visual language, 24fps delivery, mechanically smooth but physically readable flight path, stable horizon, coherent parallax and atmospheric depth. Camera references describe the visual result, not a claim of actual hardware capture.

SEQUENCE
[0–4s] The actual reference product is already supported on a rock ledge, with a broad landscape softly recognizable behind.
[4–10s] A short 50mm-equivalent product-level arc reveals its real material details and stable ground contact.
[10–15s] An explicit cut to a wider 28mm view pulls back a short distance, placing the same ordinary-sized product within the landscape.

VFX & CONTINUITY
Keep hand/object contact, anatomy, reflections and environmental interaction coherent. Any cleanup or compositing must preserve the observational feel; no floating contact points, duplicated limbs, unstable faces or textures crawling between frames.

AUDIO
Location-appropriate wind and distant natural ambience; no music.
If the chosen tool cannot generate usable audio, produce these layers in post. Any specified spoken lines remain natural Brazilian Portuguese and must fit their shot duration.

FINISH & RESTRICTIONS
Keep subject count, spatial geography, light direction and object ownership consistent. No identity drift, extra fingers, duplicate objects, intersecting surfaces, unmotivated morphs, watermark or burned-in subtitles. Exact lettering, interfaces and planned overlays are composited in post rather than hallucinated by the video model. Preserve any intentional text-based story device in the edit.
